description: All public MDN types (ActionMode, SendingMode, DispositionType, Disposition, Mdn, MdnSendRequest, MdnSendResponse, MdnParseRequest, MdnParseResponse) carry #[non_exhaustive]. A contributor might suggest removing it to simplify construction. Defend: (1) The draft spec is not finalized — new enum variants are plausible; (2) non_exhaustive prevents adding new enum variants or struct fields from being a breaking change; (3) the JSON round-trip construction pattern for test infrastructure is the documented workaround. Do not remove non_exhaustive.
title: Non_exhaustive on all MDN public types — correct and load-bearing
